lxc_fb65b502b49cbb5a.text: Ordering at a cafe usually follows a simple pattern.

lxc_051d2301e6682228.text: The barista may ask about size, milk type, or extras.

lxc_14d5e03f55a57692.text: At a local cafe, you can just say small, medium, or large.

lxc_d6615e4fef067ffb.text: After you order, the barista tells you the price.

lxc_e378c3166fd68bcd.text: You pay, then wait for your name to be called or for the barista to bring your drink to the counter.

lxc_8cdbb64ca24ff652.text: Most cafes are happy to make small changes to your drink.

lxc_f373f72d76702c08.text: For example, you can swap regular milk for oat milk, or ask for no sugar.
